{{Quote|We're not going to hold them off. We're going to push past them, and march to the black heart of our enemy!|Satele Shan leads the charge on Rhen Var|<ref name="The Old Republic—The Lost Suns 1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Mekhis]] [[Battle of Rhen Var|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] and set up a '''fortress''' in one of the world's [[Water/Legends|snowy]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountainscapes]]. The fortress served as her command center until it was breached by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]], who proceeded to engage and defeat the Sith Lord.
